claims.claim: On the 456 synthetic documents of the dpp-ai-compliance-lab goldset v0.3.0 (synthetic and synthetic-augmented; the 44 semi-synthetic excluded), the privacy detector in the strict strategy detects with precision 0.9588, recall 1.0, F1 0.979 (detection counts the 271 case anchors RIT/RUC that are detected and kept); counting only what it masks, F1 0.8834; recall 1.0 for RUT, email and phone. The baseline is the uncommitted working tree of dpp-ai-compliance-lab over 0d1e386 (F1 0.9425); 0d1e386 itself scores 0.8078. The goldset has low diversity (16 distinct names, 10 RUT values): it is a regression check, not evidence of generalization.
claims.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ~/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_privacidad.py -k test_benchmark_goldset -q -p no:cacheprovider

claims.claim: Content search over the sealed corpus (POST /grafo/buscar, scripts/panel.py grafo buscar) is a development measurement within the sample: recall@10 0.952, recall@5 0.823, mrr@10 0.636 over the 31 frozen queries of normas_qrels_v1, which cover 4 of the 25 statutes. The qrels were frozen with this same StarterCorpusRetriever and its constants were fixed while looking at the source goldset, so the numbers are not an independent holdout estimate. The qrels file is not in this repository, so this measurement cannot be reproduced from it.
claims.command: HOME=<generation>/home PYTHONPATH=motor python scripts/medir_busqueda.py --qrels <normas_qrels_v1.json> --corpus <generation>/users/hermes/starter/chile-base/current

claims.claim: The packaged matter tree (data/arbol/, 85 nodes, 51 anchors) explains content-search queries without reordering them: over the same 31 normas_qrels_v1 queries the ranking metrics are unchanged (0.823 / 0.952 / 0.636), the classification is clear (top1/top2 ratio >= 1.6) in 8 of 31, and the top-1 matter's territory contains the statute of an expected article in 14 of 31. It is an explanation of the classification, not a quality improvement. The qrels file is not in this repository, so this measurement cannot be reproduced from it.
claims.command: HOME=<generation>/home PYTHONPATH=motor python scripts/medir_busqueda.py --qrels <normas_qrels_v1.json> --corpus <generation>/users/hermes/starter/chile-base/current  # fields clara, materia_top1_cubre_esperado
